description: Deploy a Storage Account with Key Vault for customer-managed keys (CMK) in Southeast Asia. The Storage Account uses a User-Assigned Managed Identity to access the Key Vault encryption key.

resources.name: kv-stcmk-dev-<uniqueString>
resources.notes: Stores the customer-managed encryption key for the Storage Account. Purge protection and soft delete required for CMK.

resources.name: cmk-storage
resources.notes: RSA 2048-bit key used for Storage Account customer-managed key encryption.

resources.displayName: RBAC: Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User
resources.notes: Grants the User-Assigned Managed Identity the Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User role on the Key Vault.

resources.name: ststcmkdev<uniqueString>
resources.notes: Encrypted with customer-managed key from Key Vault via User-Assigned Managed Identity.
